notes.text: trackpad_log_once_ordered FAILED as frozen. The check required keyboard descriptor < trackpad metadata/descriptor < result < first queue line. The adapter source (my code) prints the keyboard-descriptor IOLog in startHardware only after enumerate() returns (PDM1SPIHID.cpp:154-157), while enumerateTrackpad logs its metadata and descriptor lines inside enumerate() (L266, L279). The source-consistent order is therefore trackpad metadata < trackpad descriptor < keyboard descriptor < result < first queue, which is exactly what this console shows (L479 < 481 < 483 < 485 < 491), with each line appearing once. I wrote the wrong expectation. I am recording the failure, not editing the frozen check or its count. The four other parts of the check (one result line, at most one of each trackpad line, result before the first queue line, keyboard descriptor before the result) hold.

Closed run: no native key report occurred (no first-input line, PTY TX 0, response false, no REPLY), so key delivery and typing remain unproven. ENUMERATION_CAPTURED with a 110-byte descriptor is the collector's recorded verdict. Its HID meaning, report IDs and any child or pointer path belong to Grok, Astra and later work.

The trackpad enumeration added two GETs before handleStart returned and left the native lifecycle bytes unchanged: pty-rx, child.json, child-ready.json and grid-final are byte-identical to survey001's, and the BSD wait and endpoint timing are the same (59982 ms elapsed).
